title: Buccaneer Base
prerequisites: Commission #12 (rescue the heir of Bivant) has been accepted from the council clerk. It must be offered, and it needs Commission #2 (Sokal Keep) resolved (digest §3.0).
The quest is not yet resolved: the base cannot be re-entered once it is.
The party can reach the wilderness map and fixed point n, wilderness (12,31).
The digest states no party level. The full assault is five waves ending with CAPTAIN (#102) + 15 4TH LVL FIGHTER + 40 BUCCANEER.
For money scenarios: record every character's money and item list before the step.

scenarios.title: The base exists on the map only after Commission #12 is accepted
steps: Before accepting Commission #12 walk onto wilderness (12,31).
Accept Commission #12 from the clerk and walk onto (12,31) again.
expect: Before acceptance: no base prompt at (12,31).
After acceptance the game prints "YOU HAVE REACHED THE BUCCANEER BASE. A BAND OF BUCCANEERS RIDE OUT TO ESCORT YOU IN. WHAT WILL YOU DO?" with ENTER / LEAVE.
data: n = (12,31) (Western region; same in [P] and Clue Book coordinates).
Adventurer's Journal: Proclamation CXIV (heir of House Bivant) and CXX (pirates' stronghold in the Twilight Marsh), p.13-15; Tavern Tale 16 (buccaneer slave auction near Stormy Bay), p.33-34.
disagreements: [P]: the base appears 'only after you accept #12'; [GB]: possibly after reading the notice on Yarash's desk, or after receiving the quest (digest §7 item 29).
scenarios.notes: A run that reads Yarash's desk (Journal Entry 27) without accepting #12 and then visits (12,31) settles the [P]/[GB] disagreement. The west wilderness block also has "A SMALL CARAVAN OF SLAVERS RIDE BY YOU TOWARD THE BUCCANEER BASE."; its trigger is not documented. The digest's proclamation table never lists CXX (NOTES.md).

scenarios.title: Enter the base and be led to the merchants' camp
steps: At (12,31) choose ENTER.
The game prints "YOU ARE JUST INSIDE THE MAIN GATE OF THE BUCCANEER'S BASE. YOU ARE BEING TAKEN TO THE CENTER OF THE BASE WHERE THE MERCHANTS MAKE CAMP.".
expect: The party enters the Buccaneer Base map (ECL 1) at (0,8) and is led to the merchants' camp, location 2.
At the camp the game prints "YOU ARE IN THE MERCHANTS' CAMP AREA.".
branches: LEAVE at the prompt: stay in the wilderness.
scenarios.notes: The digest gives no coordinates for location 2.

scenarios.title: No re-entry once the quest is resolved
steps: Resolve the quest (success or failure) and leave the base.
Walk onto wilderness (12,31) again.
expect: The base prompt is not offered; the party cannot enter the base again.
scenarios.notes: Digest: 'no re-entry once resolved'. What, if anything, prints at (12,31) afterwards is not stated.

scenarios.title: Resting: safe only at the merchants' camp
steps: Case 1: encamp and rest at the merchants' camp (location 2) without the boy.
Case 2: encamp and rest anywhere else in the base.
Case 3: holding the boy, rest anywhere.
expect: Case 1: rest completes.
Case 2: the party is rousted: "A GUARD COMES BY AND SAYS 'IF YOU WISH TO CAMP, GO TO THE MERCHANTS AREA!'".
Case 3: rest is interrupted at once.
scenarios.notes: Clue Book: 'Your party can camp here as long as it likes.' The digest does not say what interrupts rest in case 3 (presumably "SOME OF THE GUARDS SPOT YOU WITH THE BOY.").

scenarios.title: Buy a pass from the huckster (location 6)
steps: Walk to location 6 (2,11). The game prints "THERE IS A SEEDY LITTLE MAN HERE WHO WHISPERS 'PSSST, BUDDY. WANT TO BUY A PASS TO SEE THE CAPTAIN?'" with BUY PASS / LEAVE.
With a chosen character active, choose BUY PASS. The game prints "YOU BUY THE PASS. THE SEEDY LITTLE MAN DISAPPEARS AROUND A CORNER.".
expect: The active character's money is reduced by 25%; the other characters' money is unchanged.
A pass is in the inventory as an item.
The huckster is gone from (2,11).
data: 6 = (2,11). Price: 25% of the current character's money.
sources: Location numbers differ: Clue Book 1 front gate, 2 merchants' camp, 3 captain's guards, 4 captain's quarters, 5 barracks, 6 guard towers, 7 animal pen, 8 slave pen, 9 slave pen guards, 10 huckster; [P] 2 camp, 3 slave-pen view, 4 guards, 5 captain, 6 huckster, 7 towers, 8 barracks, 10 animal pen, 11 pen entrance, 12 pen, E gate
disagreements: Price: [P] '25% of the current character's money'; [GB] '125 platinum pieces' (digest §7 item 23).
scenarios.notes: The digest calls the pass 'an inventory item' without giving its item name. It does not say what happens for a character with no money; since the price is a percentage, a penniless buyer pays nothing. Rounding is not given.

scenarios.title: Show the pass to the captain's guards (location 4)
steps: Holding the pass, walk to location 4 (7,11). The game prints "STANDING IN FRONT OF THE DOOR ARE TWO LARGE GUARDS. ONE OF THEM SAYS 'DO YOU HAVE A PASS TO SEE THE CAPTAIN?' WHAT WILL YOU DO?" with SHOW PASS / LEAVE / BRIBE / ATTACK.
Choose SHOW PASS. The game prints "THE GUARDS LOOK AT YOUR PASS AND LET YOU PASS.".
expect: The party can walk on to location 5 (7,12) with no fight.
branches: SHOW PASS without a pass: "YOU DO NOT HAVE A PASS TO SHOW THE GUARDS!".
BRIBE: "YOU OFFER THE GUARDS SOME MONEY BUT THEY REFUSE. ONE OF THE GUARDS SAYS 'GET OTTA' HERE YA SCUM'" with ATTACK / LEAVE; bribes never work.
sources: Location numbers differ: Clue Book 1 front gate, 2 merchants' camp, 3 captain's guards, 4 captain's quarters, 5 barracks, 6 guard towers, 7 animal pen, 8 slave pen, 9 slave pen guards, 10 huckster; [P] 2 camp, 3 slave-pen view, 4 guards, 5 captain, 6 huckster, 7 towers, 8 barracks, 10 animal pen, 11 pen entrance, 12 pen, E gate
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say whether the pass is consumed or whether a refused bribe costs money.

scenarios.title: Attack the guards at 4 and capture the base in five waves
steps: At location 4 (7,11) choose ATTACK. Combat 1: 2 4TH LVL FIGHTER. Win it (327 XP).
The game prints "YOU KILL THE GUARDS BUT ARE CAUGHT DOING IT. A LARGE GROUP OF GUARDS RUN TOWARD YOU AND ATTACK.". Wave 2: 1 3RD LVL FIGHTER + 20 BUCCANEER. Win it.

"AFTER DEFEATING THE FIRST WAVE OF BUCCANEERS, YOU SEE ANOTHER WAVE FORMING IN THE DISTANCE. WITH A LOUD ROAR THEY ATTACK YOU IN FULL FORCE.". Wave 3: 1 5TH LVL FIGHTER + 1 3RD LVL FIGHTER + 50 BUCCANEER. Win it.
"AFTER DEFEATING THE LAST, WAVE YOU SEE ANOTHER WAVE ATTACK FROM THE SOUTH OF THE COMPOUND.". Wave 4: 1 5TH LVL FIGHTER + 2 3RD LVL FIGHTER + 53 BUCCANEER. Win it.

The game prints "THE SLAVES CHEER YOUR VICTORY. A LARGE GROUP OF BUCCANEERS STANDS IN DISBELIEF. THE BUCCANEERS PART AS A LARGE MAN IN GLEAMING CHAIN MAIL STEPS FORTH. THE SLAVES FALL SILENT." and "THE CAPTAIN SAYS 'YOU HAVE FOUGHT WELL. YOU MAY RANSOM YOURSELVES OR DIE!' WHAT WILL YOU DO?" with SURRENDER / ATTACK.
Choose ATTACK. "YOU THROW CAUTION TO THE WIND AND ATTACK. THE CAPTAIN SMILES AND THEN RUSHES TO BATTLE.". Wave 5: CAPTAIN (#102) + 15 4TH LVL FIGHTER + 40 BUCCANEER. Win it.
The game prints "AFTER DEFEATING THE LAST OF THE BUCCANNEERS THE REST SURRENDER OR FLEE. YOU RESCUE THE SLAVES AND CAPTURE THE FORT.".
expect: Wave 5 gives 3561 XP per character if the captain was still alive to fight in it.
The base is captured, the slaves are freed and the heir is rescued: the quest is a success.
branches: SURRENDER at the captain's offer: scenario surrender-to-the-captain.
fights: Wave 5: CAPTAIN (#102) + 15 4TH LVL FIGHTER + 40 BUCCANEER, 3561 XP if the captain is alive.
scenarios.notes: The digest gives XP only for combat 1 and wave 5, no morale, and does not say whether rest is possible between waves. 'If the captain is alive' covers a party that already killed him at location 5; wave 5's composition and XP without him are not given. The script line "THE LAST OF THE BUCCANNEERS FORM INTO A FINAL WAVE AND ATTACK." probably introduces wave 5 on the alert path.

scenarios.title: Surrender after wave 4: ransom, expulsion, mission failed
steps: At the captain's offer after wave 4 choose SURRENDER.
The game prints "THE CAPTAIN SAYS 'YOU HAVE CHOSEN WISELY.' SOME OF THE BUCCANEERS COME FORWARD AND STRIP YOU OF SOME OF YOUR ITEMS AND MONEY. THEY ESCORT YOU OUT OF THE COMPOUND.".
expect: The party loses 75% of its money and 50% of its light items.
The party is put outside the base on the wilderness map.
The quest is resolved as a failure; the base cannot be re-entered.
At the clerk the failure line appears: 'By the way, your bungling the Bivant rescue has cost us.' (digest §3.0).
data: Loss: 75% of money, 50% of light items.
sources: digest §5 Other documented quirks (item theft: surrenders)
scenarios.notes: The digest does not define 'light items'. Digest §5 says ECL opcode 28 (ROB) handles the item chance incorrectly; assert the money loss exactly and record the item loss against a reference run. The clerk's failure line is quoted in mixed case from the guide.

scenarios.title: Buy the boy from the captain (location 5)
steps: After showing the pass walk to location 5 (7,12). The game prints "YOU ENTER A ROOM WITH FOUR GUARDS IN GLEAMING CHAIN MAIL. AS YOU ENTER, ONE OF THEM GOES THROUGH THE SOUTH DOOR AND RETURNS WITH THE BUCCANEER CAPTAIN." and "THE CAPTAIN LOOKS YOU OVER AND SAYS 'WHAT DO YOU WANT?'" with ATTACK / MENTION YOUNG BOY / LEAVE.

Choose MENTION YOUNG BOY. The game prints "YOU MENTION THE YOUNG BOY IN THE SLAVE PEN AND THE CAPTAIN SEEMS INTERESTED. HE SAYS 'I CAN LET YOU BUY THE YOUNG BOY BUT IT WILL COST YOU ALOT!' WHAT WILL YOU DO?" with BUY THE BOY / ATTACK.

Choose BUY THE BOY. The game prints "THE CAPTAIN SAYS 'YOU HAVE MADE A GOOD DEAL.' AFTER TALKING THE CAPTAIN MAKES A MOTION AND THE BOY IS BROUGHT TO YOU." and "THE CAPTAIN THEN LEAVES THE ROOM AND YOU ARE ESCORTED BACK OUTSIDE.".
Walk to the gate E and leave the base.
expect: The party loses 75% of its money and 10% of its light items.
The boy is with the party.
Leaving the base with the boy resolves the quest as a success.
branches: ATTACK at either menu: scenario kill-the-captain.
data: 5 = (7,12). Price: 75% of the party's money and 10% of light items.
sources: Location numbers differ: Clue Book 1 front gate, 2 merchants' camp, 3 captain's guards, 4 captain's quarters, 5 barracks, 6 guard towers, 7 animal pen, 8 slave pen, 9 slave pen guards, 10 huckster; [P] 2 camp, 3 slave-pen view, 4 guards, 5 captain, 6 huckster, 7 towers, 8 barracks, 10 animal pen, 11 pen entrance, 12 pen, E gate
disagreements: Price of the boy: [P]/[GB] 75% of money (and 10% of light items per [P]); [NES] '35000 GP' (NES only; digest §7 item 23).
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say whether buying the boy stops the guards from reacting to him ('SOME OF THE GUARDS SPOT YOU WITH THE BOY') or whether resting is still interrupted; [P] says 'Leave promptly'.

scenarios.title: The boy can be bought with no money
steps: Reach the captain with every character holding zero money (drop or pool it away first; the pass costs 25% of the buyer's money, so a penniless buyer still gets one).
Choose MENTION YOUNG BOY, then BUY THE BOY.
expect: The purchase succeeds: "THE CAPTAIN SAYS 'YOU HAVE MADE A GOOD DEAL.' AFTER TALKING THE CAPTAIN MAKES A MOTION AND THE BOY IS BROUGHT TO YOU." and the boy joins the party.
Money stays at zero; 10% of light items are still taken.
scenarios.notes: Digest: '"B"uy him for 75% of the party's money and 10% of light items (no money actually required)' and, under Outcomes, 'buy the boy (no money needed)'. The price is a percentage with no minimum. A faithful port must not add a minimum price.

scenarios.title: Attack the captain in his quarters
steps: At location 5 (7,12) choose ATTACK. The game prints "YOU DRAW YOUR WEAPONS AND ATTACK. THE CAPTAIN DRAWS HIS SWORD AND YELLS FOR HIS GUARDS TO ATTACK!".
Combat: CAPTAIN (#102) + 4 4TH LVL FIGHTER. Win it. The game prints "YOU KILL THE CAPTAIN.".
expect: Each character gains 1669 XP.
Loot: Long Sword +4, Shield +2, Plate Mail +3.
The base is not on alert after a win.
branches: Running from this fight: "YOU HAVE RUN OUTSIDE THE CAPTAINS QUARTERS. AN ALARM GOES OFF IN THE DISTANCE. YOU SEE A LARGE GROUP OF ANGRY BUCCANEERS CHARGING TOWARD YOU!"; the base goes on alert (scenario alert-random-encounters).
data: Loot: Long Sword +4, Shield +2, Plate Mail +3.
scenarios.notes: Killing the captain does not free the heir; the party must still get him from the pen (location 12). Digest: 'This does not alert the base. Running away does.'

scenarios.title: The sleazy merchant at the slave pen (location 3)
steps: Walk to location 3. The game prints "YOU ARE JUST OUTSIDE A PEN FOR HOLDING SLAVES. THE PEOPLE HERE ARE WORN AND BEATEN, DESTINED TO A LIFE OF SLAVERY. AROUND THE PEN THERE ARE MANY GUARDS AND SLEAZY MERCHANTS LOOKING AT THE SLAVES.", "YOU SEE A BOY THAT HAS A HEART-SHAPED BIRTHMARK ON HIS LEFT SHOULDER. AS YOU STARE AT THE BOY, A SLEAZY FAT MERCHANT APPROACHES YOU AND SAYS ..." and "'THAT YOUNG BOY WILL BRING A GOOD PRICE AT ZHENTIL KEEP. I THINK I SHALL BUY HIM.'".
The menu is PUNCH MERCHANT / AGREE / SAY NOTHING / RESCUE BOY.

Case 1: PUNCH MERCHANT. "YOU PUNCH THE MERCHANT IN THE NOSE AND HE FALLS TO THE GROUND, BADLY BLEEDING. THE MERCHANT YELLS FOR HIS GUARDS AND THEY COME RUNNING."; combat with 6 BUCCANEER; after winning, "AFTER YOU DEFEAT THE GUARDS YOU SEE A CROWD HAS FORMED. FROM WITHIN THE CROWD A LARGE MAN IN GLEAMING CHAIN MAIL STEPS OUT. HE SAYS 'THAT WAS AMUSING BUT DO NOT CAUSE ANYMORE TROUBLE!'" and "THE MAN THEN LEAVES AND BEFORE YOU IS THE SLEAZY MERCHANT. HE BEGS FORGIVENESS THEN WIMPERS AWAY.".
Case 2: AGREE. "YOU AGREE WITH THE MERCHANT THAT THE YOUNG BOY IS VALUABLE. THE MERCHANT LAUGHS THEN SAYS 'YOU'LL HAVE TO OUTBID ME FOR THE WAIF.' THE SLEAZY MERCHANT THEN WALKS AWAY.".
Case 3: SAY NOTHING.
Case 4: RESCUE BOY. "YOU IGNORE THE SLEAZY MERCHANT AND CONCENTRATE ON RESCUING THE BOY." then SNEAK INTO PEN / ATTACK GUARDS / DO NOT RESCUE BOY NOW.
expect: Case 1: the fight is 6 BUCCANEER; the base is not put on alert (the captain says 'THAT WAS AMUSING BUT DO NOT CAUSE ANYMORE TROUBLE!').
Cases 2 and 3: no fight; the merchant leaves.
Case 4, SNEAK INTO PEN: "YOU MOVE THROUGH THE CROWD NONCHALANTLY UNTIL YOU ARE NEAR THE FRONT GATE OF THE SLAVE PEN." and the party is at the pen entrance, location 11 (7,6).
branches: Fleeing the punch fight: "YOU RUN AWAY FROM THE BATTLE BACK TO THE MERCHANT'S AREA. FROM BEHIND YOU HEAR PEOPLE CALLING YOU NAMES LIKE 'PANSY' AND 'WIMP.'".
ATTACK GUARDS in case 4: "YOU ATTACK THE GUARDS." (scenario slave-pen-entrance).
DO NOT RESCUE BOY NOW: nothing changes.
fights: Punch merchant: 6 BUCCANEER; XP not given.
scenarios.notes: No coordinates for location 3 in the digest. 'The base is not put on alert' in case 1 is read from the captain's line, not stated by the digest. The pen also has two static lines: "YOU ARE JUST OUTSIDE THE SLAVE PEN. AMOUNG THE SLAVES IS A YOUNG BOY WITH A HEART-SHAPED BIRTHMARK." and "YOU ARE JUST OUTSIDE THE SLAVE PEN.".

scenarios.title: Release the animals for a 60-minute distraction (location 10)
steps: Walk to location 10 (11,6). The game prints "YOU ARE AT THE GATE TO THE ANIMAL PENS. THE ANIMALS ARE RESTLESS. WHAT WILL YOU DO?" with RELEASE ANIMALS / LEAVE.

Choose RELEASE ANIMALS. The game prints "AS SOON AS YOU OPEN THE GATE THE ANIMALS INSIDE CHARGE OUT. THEY STAMPEDE ACROSS THE COMPOUND." and "THERE IS MASS CONFUSION AS THE ANIMALS RUN AROUND THE COMPOUND. GUARDS ARE LEAVING THEIR POSTS IN ORDER TO CONTROL THE ANIMALS.".
Note the game clock. Wait 60 minutes of game time.
expect: For 60 minutes the guards are distracted: the slave-pen entrance at 11 is unguarded and the gate fight does not occur.
While they are loose the game shows "ANIMALS ARE RUNNING ALL OVER THE COMPOUND."; when the time is up, "THE ANIMALS HAVE BEEN CAPTURED.".
The pens then read "YOU ARE JUST OUTSIDE SOME EMPTY ANIMAL PENS." / "YOU ARE NEAR AN OPEN DOOR TO THE ANIMAL PENS.".
sources: Location numbers differ: Clue Book 1 front gate, 2 merchants' camp, 3 captain's guards, 4 captain's quarters, 5 barracks, 6 guard towers, 7 animal pen, 8 slave pen, 9 slave pen guards, 10 huckster; [P] 2 camp, 3 slave-pen view, 4 guards, 5 captain, 6 huckster, 7 towers, 8 barracks, 10 animal pen, 11 pen entrance, 12 pen, E gate
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say whether the animals can be released a second time. Before release the pens read "YOU ARE NEAR A DENSLY PACKED ANIMAL PEN.".

scenarios.title: The slave-pen entrance (location 11)
steps: Case 1: while the animals are loose walk to location 11 (7,6). The game prints "YOU ARE JUST OUTSIDE AN UNGUARDED SLAVE PEN."; walk in.
Case 2: with the animals penned walk to (7,6). The game prints "YOU ARE NEAR THE FRONT GATE TO THE SLAVE PEN. TWO GUARDS GUARD THE DOOR. WHAT WILL YOU DO?" with ATTACK / TRY TO SNEAK BY / LEAVE.
Case 2a: TRY TO SNEAK BY. The game prints "YOU TRY TO SNEAK UP PAST THE GUARDS BUT THEY ARE TOO ALERT. YOU CANNOT GET BY THE GUARDS INTO THE SLAVE PEN. WHAT WILL YOU DO?" with ATTACK GUARDS / LEAVE.
Case 2b: ATTACK. Combat: 4 BUCCANEER. Win it.
expect: Case 1: no guards and no fight; the party reaches location 12.
Case 2a: sneaking never succeeds, whatever the party's thieves or dice.
Case 2b: each character gains 9 XP and the entrance is open.
sources: Location numbers differ: Clue Book 1 front gate, 2 merchants' camp, 3 captain's guards, 4 captain's quarters, 5 barracks, 6 guard towers, 7 animal pen, 8 slave pen, 9 slave pen guards, 10 huckster; [P] 2 camp, 3 slave-pen view, 4 guards, 5 captain, 6 huckster, 7 towers, 8 barracks, 10 animal pen, 11 pen entrance, 12 pen, E gate
disagreements: The entrance text says 'TWO GUARDS GUARD THE DOOR'; [P] gives the fight as 4 BUCCANEER.
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say whether attacking the pen guards puts the base on alert.

scenarios.title: Get the heir from the pen (location 12) and leave
steps: Walk into location 12. The game prints "YOU ARE IN THE SLAVE PEN. STANDING NEAR YOU IS THE YOUNG BOY. WHAT WILL YOU DO?" with GET HIM / LEAVE.
Choose GET HIM. The game prints "YOU TAKE THE YOUNG BOY AND LEAVE. THE OTHER SLAVES ALSO RUN OUT THE SLAVE PEN.".
Walk to the gate E while the animals are still loose and leave the base.
expect: The boy is with the party and every slave is freed.
With the animals loose there is no fight at the gate.
The party is on the wilderness map and the quest is resolved as a success (freed by force).
branches: If the 60 minutes run out, or the base is on alert: "SOME OF THE GUARDS SPOT YOU WITH THE BOY." and "AN ALARM GOES OFF IN THE DISTANCE. YOUR ONLY HOPE IS TO RUN FOR THE FRONT GATE."; see scenarios gate-fight and alert-random-encounters.
data: Gate text: "YOU ARE NEAR THE MAIN GATE TO THE COMPOUND. SOME BUCCANEERS STAND GUARD NEAR THE ENTRANCE." / "YOU ARE AT THE MAIN GATE TO THE COMPOUND.".
scenarios.notes: No coordinates for 12 or E in the digest (the entry square is (0,8)). The digest does not say how the boy is represented (party member, item or flag); a runner should read the flag. Clue Book route: 'open the animal pen and stampede the animals, move over and free the boy, and then run for the front gate.'

scenarios.title: The heir can be 'got' again
steps: Already holding the boy (bought from the captain, or taken from the pen), walk into location 12.
The menu GET HIM / LEAVE is offered again. Choose GET HIM.
expect: The game prints "YOU TAKE THE YOUNG BOY AND LEAVE. THE OTHER SLAVES ALSO RUN OUT THE SLAVE PEN." again and every slave is freed, although the party already has the boy.
sources: digest §5 Scripting: 'Buccaneer Base: you can "Get" the heir again.'
scenarios.notes: A bug of the original that the port must reproduce: the pen does not check that the boy is already with the party.

scenarios.title: Force a guard tower (location 7)
steps: Walk into a guard tower. The game prints "YOU HAVE ENTERED ONE OF THE GUARD TOWERS. INSIDE ARE FOUR BUCCANEERS. ONE OF THEM SAYS 'THIS IS A RESTRICTED AREA, LEAVE NOW!' WHAT WILL YOU DO?" with ATTACK / LEAVE.
Choose ATTACK: "YOU ATTACK THE TOWER GUARDS.". Combat: 4 BUCCANEER. Win it.
expect: Each character gains 9 XP.
LEAVE avoids the fight.
sources: Location numbers differ: Clue Book 1 front gate, 2 merchants' camp, 3 captain's guards, 4 captain's quarters, 5 barracks, 6 guard towers, 7 animal pen, 8 slave pen, 9 slave pen guards, 10 huckster; [P] 2 camp, 3 slave-pen view, 4 guards, 5 captain, 6 huckster, 7 towers, 8 barracks, 10 animal pen, 11 pen entrance, 12 pen, E gate
scenarios.notes: A second wording, "THE TOWER GUARDS ATTACK.", exists; its trigger (probably the base on alert) is not in the digest. The digest gives no tower coordinates and does not say whether this alerts the base.

scenarios.title: Force the barracks (location 8)
steps: Walk into the barracks. The game prints "YOU ENTER A BARRACKS FILED WITH TWENTY BUCCANEERS. ONE OF THE BUCCANEERS SAYS 'THIS AREA IS OFF LIMITS. LEAVE NOW.' WHAT WILL YOU DO?" with ATTACK / LEAVE.
Choose ATTACK: "YOU ATTACK THE BUCCANEERS.". Wave 1: 20 BUCCANEER.
In a second run enter the barracks while the animals are loose.
expect: Attacking starts 5 waves, the first of 20 BUCCANEER.
While the animals are loose the game prints "YOU ENTER AN EMPTY BARRACKS. IT SEEMS MOST OF THE MEN ARE OUTSIDE CHASING THE ANIMALS." and there is no fight.
fights: 5 waves starting with 20 BUCCANEER; later waves not listed by the digest.
sources: Location numbers differ: Clue Book 1 front gate, 2 merchants' camp, 3 captain's guards, 4 captain's quarters, 5 barracks, 6 guard towers, 7 animal pen, 8 slave pen, 9 slave pen guards, 10 huckster; [P] 2 camp, 3 slave-pen view, 4 guards, 5 captain, 6 huckster, 7 towers, 8 barracks, 10 animal pen, 11 pen entrance, 12 pen, E gate
disagreements: The digest does not mention the empty barracks during the stampede; the game text has it.
scenarios.notes: Digest: '8 barracks: 5 waves starting with 20 BUCCANEER.' The later four waves are probably the alert waves (4 3RD LVL + 30, 4 3RD LVL + 40, then the captain's wave), but the digest does not say so. A second wording, "THE GUARDS IN THE BARRACKS ATTACK.", exists.

scenarios.title: Gate guards attack when the base is on alert
steps: Put the base on alert (for example by running from the captain's fight) with the animals penned, then walk to the gate E.
The game prints "SOME GUARDS RUSH FOWARD AND ATTACK.". Combat: 8 BUCCANEER.
In a second run reach the gate on alert while the animals are loose.
expect: Alert and animals penned: 8 BUCCANEER attack at the gate.
Animals loose: no gate fight.
Not on alert: no gate fight.
fights: Gate E: 8 BUCCANEER; XP not given.
disagreements: Clue Book: the gate 'is always guarded, but the guards may be distracted if the animals are stampeding'; [P]: a fight only 'if the base is on alert and the animals are penned'.

scenarios.title: Alert-state random encounters
steps: Put the base on alert and walk around with the animals penned; count the alert fights already fought (F).
Repeat with the animals loose.
expect: Chance per check is (F + 1) in 12 with the animals penned and (F + 1) in 13 while they are free.
Alert wave 1: 20 BUCCANEER. Wave 2: 4 3RD LVL FIGHTER + 30 BUCCANEER. Wave 3: 4 3RD LVL FIGHTER + 40 BUCCANEER. Wave 4: CAPTAIN (#102) + 15 4TH LVL FIGHTER + 40 BUCCANEER (as wave 5 at location 4).
Each wave is announced by "ANOTHER WAVE OF MEN ATTACK YOU.".
fights: Wave 1: 20 BUCCANEER. Wave 2: 4 3RD LVL + 30 BUCCANEER. Wave 3: 4 3RD LVL + 40 BUCCANEER. Wave 4: as wave 5 at location 4.
data: (fights + 1) in 12, or in 13 while the animals are free.
scenarios.notes: The digest does not say whether the check is per step or per time, what exactly sets the alert besides running from the captain, or what follows wave 4 (probably the capture of the base). With fixed dice a runner can assert the die sizes 12 and 13. Clue Book: 'The longer your party takes to exit the compound, the more groups of buccaneers they'll have to fight.' On alert the captain's quarters print "AS YOU APPROACH THE CAPTAIN'S QUARTERS THE ELITE GUARDS SOUND AN ALARM AND GUARDS RUSH FORTH AND ATTACK.".

scenarios.title: Flee combat with the boy: warning, then failure
steps: Holding the boy, get into an alert fight and flee it.
The game prints "YOU TRY TO RUN FROM THE GUARDS BUT ARE CUT OFF BY NEW ARRIVALS. THE YOUNG BOY IS SLOWING YOU DOWN. IF YOU RUN AGAIN YOU WILL LEAVE HIM BEHIND.".
Flee again.
The game prints "YOU RUN FROM THE BATTLE AND OUT THE OUTPOST GATE. THE YOUNG BOY COULD NOT KEEP UP AND WAS LEFT BEHIND.".
expect: After the first flight the boy is still with the party (a warning only).
After the second the party is outside the base without the boy; the quest is resolved as a failure and the base cannot be re-entered.
The clerk later says 'By the way, your bungling the Bivant rescue has cost us.'
scenarios.notes: Digest: 'Failure: surrender, or abandon the boy by fleeing combat (you may get a warning first).' The 'may' means the warning is not guaranteed; the digest does not give the condition, so a runner should record whether the warning appears on the first flight.

scenarios.title: Collect the Commission #12 reward
steps: Resolve the quest as a success (boy bought, boy freed by force, or base captured) and leave the base.
Return to New Phlan City Hall and speak to the council clerk at location 29 (5,5).
expect: The clerk pays 5 jewelry and 25 gems, a Two-Handed Sword +1, +3 Vs. Undead and 4 Clerical Scroll (Restoration, Restoration); each character gains 3208 XP.
Commission #12 does not advance the quest tracker (it is not among the ten tracker quests).
branches: After a failure the clerk gives no reward and says 'By the way, your bungling the Bivant rescue has cost us.'
data: Reward: 5 jewelry, 25 gems, Two-Handed Sword +1, +3 Vs. Undead, 4 Clerical Scroll (Restoration, Restoration) (3208 XP).
sources: [P] §3.0 clerk commission list and tracker list
scenarios.notes: The same sword-and-scrolls package is the accept reward of the special Valhingen commission (digest §3.0); the digest does not say whether a party gets both. Clue Book finale: 'The boy will be returned to his parents and the party will receive a generous reward.'
